d.x: The harder you try to sleep, the greater the chances you'll end up gnashing your teeth all night rather than stacking some Zzzs.

zzzs.e: From zzz, a cartoon depiction of snoring; compare zs.

d.x: Likewise, the ZZ plant (zamioculcas) is tolerant of a wide range of conditions, from searing sunlight to heavy shade. As a student I forgot to water one for months in the height of summer and the only reaction was that its growth rate slowed.

ZZ plant.e: From the initialism of the species name Zamioculcas zamiifolia.
